attack_generator.budget_mode: absolute coordinatewise L_inf on selected parameter tensors

delta_provenance.storage: lossless gzip of float32 torch delta artifact; raw SHA-256 recorded before compression; gzip SHA-256 recorded after compression

fixed_epsilon_role: .05/.1/.2 are retained as secondary implementation-space stress points only; fixed-epsilon ADS/Drop must not be used as intrinsic specificity or robustness ranking.
interpretation_lock: Specificity claims are damage-matched within PE family/seed across attack surfaces.
Fixed absolute epsilon is an implementation-space coordinate, not an intrinsic cross-surface fairness scale.
all_non_pe_weights is the canonical symmetric replacement for historical all_weights.
Historical specificity numbers are provenance only.

all_non_pe_weights.definition: all trainable model parameters except semantic PE objects; includes biases/norms/cls token/head/patch embedding/etc., excludes pos_embed/.pe/cos_cached/sin_cached/inv_freq/slope-like PE state

mlp_only.definition: all MLP weight matrices only (two per block); biases excluded

primary_estimands.gate: 5/10/20 pp must be estimable for all 4 PE x 6 seeds x 4 surfaces = 96 units per target; otherwise targeted refinement required before manuscript use
primary_estimands.matching_rule: within each PE x seed x surface: first adjacent crossing in ascending epsilon; exact hit direct; otherwise linear interpolation in task damage; identical interpolation weight for epsilon, 12-layer ADS profile, and per-image [256,12] ADS; no extrapolation

scientific_question: Does canonical ADS characterize PE-only tampering differently from QKV-only, MLP-only, and a symmetric all-non-PE trainable-parameter control when comparisons are made at matched task damage?

secondary_estimand.severe_50pct_clean: first bracket where attacked accuracy <= 50% of that checkpoint clean accuracy; no extrapolation; not a common cross-surface gate

source_pe_only.reuse_rule: No new PE-only PGD. Reuse exact EXP-014 cell results and per-image canonical ADS artifacts.
